cues.en: Instructor: P-values.
cues.zh: 講師：P 值。

cues.en: Statistics are all about p-values.
cues.zh: 統計都是在談 P 值。

cues.en: You hear this all the time.
cues.zh: 你經常聽到。

cues.en: P is less than 0.05 or P is this or P is that.
cues.zh: P 小於 0.05，或 P 是這個、那個。

cues.en: P-values are super important in modern inferential statistics.
cues.zh: P 值在現代推論統計中非常重要。

cues.en: So this video is all about p-values, where they come from, what they mean, what they don't mean.
cues.zh: 所以這部影片都在談 P 值，從哪裡來、有什麼意義，以及不代表什麼。

cues.en: And I'll also talk about tails of distributions, what it means for a p-value to be one tailed or two tailed.
cues.zh: 也會談分布的尾部，P 值是單尾或雙尾代表什麼。

cues.en: So let's begin where we left off in the previous video, which is that we can conceptualize these two different distributions.
cues.zh: 從前一部影片結尾開始，可以想像這兩個不同分布。

cues.en: One distribution corresponding to the sample statistics or the sample effects estimates under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 一個對應虛無假設下的樣本統計量，或樣本效果估計值。

cues.en: And another distribution of the sample estimates under the alternative hypothesis, so the interesting hypothesis.
cues.zh: 另一個是對立假設，也就是有趣假設下，樣本估計值的分布。

cues.en: Now the thing is that when you do actual research in a real experiment, this thing, this null hypothesis distribution, this usually comes from a formula.
cues.zh: 實際進行真實實驗時，這個虛無假設分布通常來自公式。

cues.en: You look this up in a formula and it's based on assumptions, it's based on the kind of statistic tests that you're doing.
cues.zh: 從公式取得，依據假設、正在做的統計檢定類型。

cues.en: It's based on the degrees of freedom, which is a concept I'll talk about in a few videos from now.
cues.zh: 也依據自由度，這個概念再過幾部影片會談。

cues.en: So this null hypothesis distribution doesn't come from your data, this comes from a formula.
cues.zh: 所以虛無假設分布不是來自資料，而是來自公式。

cues.en: So we get the entire distribution.
cues.zh: 可以取得整個分布。

cues.en: On the other hand, the alternative hypothesis, we don't have a formula for that.
cues.zh: 另一方面，對立假設沒有對應公式。

cues.en: That's the whole purpose of science.
cues.zh: 這就是科學的目的。

cues.en: I mean, if we had a formula for everything in the universe, we wouldn't need to do empirical science.
cues.zh: 如果宇宙一切都有公式，就不需要實證科學。

cues.en: So in fact, in real experiments, when you're really doing statistics, the situation looks more like this.
cues.zh: 所以真正做實驗、統計時，情況比較像這樣。

cues.en: You have your null hypothesis distribution, and this is analytic.
cues.zh: 有虛無假設分布，這是解析的。

cues.en: This you get from evaluating a formula at a bunch of different values.
cues.zh: 在一批不同值上計算公式，就能取得。

cues.en: But your alternative hypothesis value, this is what you empirically gather.
cues.zh: 但對立假設的值，是透過實驗收集的。

cues.en: You do, you know, you get a bunch of people to do your experiment.
cues.zh: 找一群人參加實驗。

cues.en: So you get one dataset, you get one sample, you get one statistic from that sample, maybe this is a mean.
cues.zh: 得到一組資料、一個樣本，再由樣本得到一個統計量，也許是平均值。

cues.en: You get one mean value.
cues.zh: 得到一個平均值。

cues.en: So this is the way to think about it, that you have a distribution of sample statistics under the alternative hypothesis, but in practice you just end up with one value.
cues.zh: 可以這樣想，對立假設下有樣本統計量的分布，但實務上只得到一個值。

cues.en: And that value can sort of, you know, it's gonna be wherever it's gonna be relative to this null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這個值相對虛無假設分布，會落在某個位置。

cues.en: So that leads us to the concept of a p-value and here we're gonna ask questions.
cues.zh: 這就帶到 P 值概念，這裡要提問。

cues.en: I'm actually gonna pose three questions, but they're kind of all the same question, they're just phrased in different ways.
cues.zh: 其實會提出三個問題，但基本上是同一題，只是不同說法。

cues.en: Okay, so here's a question.
cues.zh: 問題如下。

cues.en: How likely is the alternative hypothesis value, so this value here, how likely is this value to occur
cues.zh: 如果虛無假設為真，這個對立假設值，

cues.en: if the null hypothesis is true?
cues.zh: 也就是這個值，出現的可能性有多高？

cues.en: So given this null hypothesis value, what is the probability of observing an effect over here at this part of the distribution?
cues.zh: 給定這個虛無假設值，在分布這個位置觀察到效果的機率是多少？

cues.en: Now I'm gonna frame that another way.
cues.zh: 再換一種問法。

cues.en: Again, this is a different way of framing the question, but it's not really a different question.
cues.zh: 只是另一種表達，並非真正不同的問題。

cues.en: What is the probability of observing a parameter estimate of HA, so the alternative hypothesis parameter?
cues.zh: 觀察到 Hₐ 的參數估計值，也就是對立假設參數，機率是多少？

cues.en: So the what is the probability of observing a parameter estimate this large or larger, given that there is no true effect?
cues.zh: 沒有真實效果的條件下，觀察到這麼大或更大參數估計值的機率是多少？

cues.en: That means given that we retain the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 也就是保留虛無假設的條件下。

cues.en: Okay, and yet another way, this is the shortest way of saying it, what is the probability of the alternative hypothesis, given the null hypothesis?
cues.zh: 再換個最簡短的說法，給定虛無假設下，對立假設的機率是多少？

cues.en: These three questions are all asking basically the same thing.
cues.zh: 這三個問題基本上都在問相同的事。

cues.en: And what is the answer?
cues.zh: 答案是什麼？

cues.en: Well, you know, for now, we don't have to worry about an exact number.
cues.zh: 現在不用擔心精確數字。

cues.en: But the answer we could say colloquially, is that here is relatively unlikely and here it is likely.
cues.zh: 但可以用日常語言說，這裡相對不可能，這裡則可能。

cues.en: So that means that a value over here on this part of the distribution, the null hypothesis distribution, this value is unlikely to occur
cues.zh: 也就是，虛無假設分布這個位置的值，在

cues.en: if the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 虛無假設為真時，不太可能出現。

cues.en: Now, that doesn't mean that it's impossible.
cues.zh: 不代表不可能。

cues.en: Of course it's not impossible, we have null hypothesis values that are larger than our alternative hypothesis value.
cues.zh: 當然不是不可能，還有比對立假設值更大的虛無假設值。

cues.en: All we're saying is that a value out here is relatively unlikely given this distribution and a value over here is pretty likely given this distribution.
cues.zh: 只是說，根據這個分布，這裡的值相對少見，那裡的值則相當常見。

cues.en: And this probability here, this is a p-value.
cues.zh: 這個機率，就是 P 值。

cues.en: The P stands for probability.
cues.zh: P 代表 probability，也就是機率。

cues.en: So the probability is, or the p-value is the probability of observing an effect as large or larger than what we observed in our data,
cues.zh: P 值是在虛無假設為真的條件下，觀察到和資料中的效果一樣大，或更大的效果，

cues.en: given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 其機率是多少。

cues.en: So I'm gonna write down that definition again in a few slides.
cues.zh: 再過幾張投影片，會重新寫出這個定義。

cues.en: First, I want to make this important concept clear.
cues.zh: 先釐清這個重要概念。

cues.en: We cannot actually prove that the alternative hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 其實無法證明對立假設為真。

cues.en: That's what I mentioned in the first video of this section.
cues.zh: 本章第一部影片提過。

cues.en: It's kind of a weird thing because you set up your experiment, you set up your research because you're interested in the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 有點奇怪，設計實驗、研究，是因為對對立假設有興趣。

cues.en: But when it comes down to doing the nitty gritty work of the inferential statistics, you don't actually test the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 但真正開始進行推論統計的細部工作時，其實不是在檢驗虛無假設。

cues.en: You don't test that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 不是檢驗虛無假設為真。

cues.en: What you do is test the probability that your test statistic associated with the alternative hypothesis could have been observed,
cues.zh: 而是在檢驗，對立假設所對應的檢定統計量，被觀察到的機率，

cues.en: given that the null hypothesis is actually the true state of the world.
cues.zh: 條件是，虛無假設確實是真實世界的狀態。

cues.en: So I hope that's clear.
cues.zh: 希望說清楚了。

cues.en: What we're actually computing with the p-value is the probability that we get our observed test value, given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 用 P 值實際計算的，是虛無假設為真時，得到所觀察檢定值的機率。

cues.en: Okay, so p-values are probabilities.
cues.zh: 所以 P 值是機率。

cues.en: They range from zero to one.
cues.zh: 範圍從 0 到 1。

cues.en: Values close to zero indicate that there is a low probability of the alternative hypothesis value, so your test statistic, given the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 接近 0，代表給定虛無假設下，對立假設值，也就是你的檢定統計量，出現機率低。

cues.en: And values close to one, indicate a high probability of observing your test statistic, given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 接近 1，代表虛無假設為真時，觀察到檢定統計量的機率高。

cues.en: So that means that values all the way out here are associated with a very small p-value.
cues.zh: 因此，遠在這裡的值，對應很小的 P 值。

cues.en: Values close to the center have a large probability value.
cues.zh: 接近中心的值，則有很大的機率值。

cues.en: And this should be intuitive, right?
cues.zh: 這應該直觀，對吧？

cues.en: So we're saying, what is the probability that this value was actually drawn from this distribution?
cues.zh: 我們在問，這個值其實從這個分布抽出的機率是多少？

cues.en: Well, it's a pretty high probability considering that it's where most of the values lie.
cues.zh: 考慮到大部分數值都在這裡，機率相當高。

cues.en: And then down here we also have a probability close to zero.
cues.zh: 下面這裡的機率也接近 0。

cues.en: So you can see that the probabilities are close to zero at the edges and they increase to close to one towards the peak of this distribution.
cues.zh: 所以機率在兩端接近 0，往分布峰值則增加到接近 1。

cues.en: So how do we translate a p-value into a claim of statistical significance?
cues.zh: 如何把 P 值轉成統計顯著性的主張？

cues.en: So the idea is that we call a finding statistically significant, that's an important term, if the test statistic, or if the value of the sample parameter is greater
cues.zh: 概念是，如果檢定統計量，或樣本參數值大於

cues.en: than some threshold.
cues.zh: 某個門檻，就稱結果具有統計顯著性，這是個重要術語。

cues.en: So we define this to be our threshold.
cues.zh: 把這裡定義為門檻。

cues.en: And we say if our test statistic is larger than this threshold, then we call it statistically significant.
cues.zh: 如果檢定統計量大於門檻，就稱統計顯著。

cues.en: If it's smaller than this threshold, we call it non-statistically significant.
cues.zh: 如果小於門檻，就稱不具有統計顯著性。

cues.en: So this finding a sample statistic out here would be called statistically significant because it's greater than the threshold.
cues.zh: 這裡的樣本統計量會被稱為統計顯著，因為大於門檻。

cues.en: And this would be called not statistically significant because it's less than the threshold.
cues.zh: 這個則不顯著，因為小於門檻。

cues.en: It's more likely to occur if the null hypothesis were true than we are willing to tolerate for our significance threshold.
cues.zh: 如果虛無假設為真，它出現的可能性，比顯著性門檻願意容許的程度更高。

cues.en: Now, it's important to realize that these thresholds are arbitrary.
cues.zh: 要知道，這些門檻是任意設定的。

cues.en: You can kind of put them wherever you want.
cues.zh: 可以放在你想要的位置。

cues.en: You could move, for this thing, imagine we take exactly this same value, but we move the threshold to the left, and now all of a sudden this finding becomes statistically significant because it is greater
cues.zh: 想像完全相同的值，但把門檻往左移，這個結果突然就變得統計顯著，因為它大於

cues.en: than our threshold, it's less likely than our probability threshold.
cues.zh: 門檻，其可能性低於我們的機率門檻。

cues.en: So the thresholds are a little bit arbitrary, but common values, values that people use, are 0.05 or 0.01.
cues.zh: 所以門檻有點任意，但常見值是 0.05 或 0.01。

cues.en: So a probability of 5% or a probability of 1% to observe a statistic as large or larger than what you found in your actual data,
cues.zh: 也就是在虛無假設為真時，觀察到和實際資料中的統計量一樣大或更大的值，機率為 5% 或 1%。

cues.en: given that the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 條件是虛無假設為真。

cues.en: Okay, so now I wanna talk about the tails of a distribution and how that affects the p-value threshold.
cues.zh: 接著談分布尾部，及其如何影響 P 值門檻。

cues.en: It's important to realize that each side of the null hypothesis distribution is unlikely.
cues.zh: 要知道，虛無假設分布的兩側都不常見。

cues.en: So if the null hypothesis is true, you are unlikely to get test statistic values all the way out here and you're also unlikely to get test statistic values all the way out here.
cues.zh: 如果虛無假設為真，不太可能得到遠在這裡的統計量，也不太可能得到遠在另一側的值。

cues.en: So when we're only testing one tail, then that's called a one-tailed test.
cues.zh: 只檢驗一側尾部，稱為單尾檢定。

cues.en: So if we are using an alpha level, a significance threshold, it's often called alpha.
cues.zh: 如果使用 α 水準，顯著性門檻經常稱為 α。

cues.en: If we are using a significant threshold alpha of 0.05 or 5%, then that means that 5% of the distribution to the right, so here in this one-tailed case,
cues.zh: 顯著性門檻 α 為 0.05，或 5%，在這個單尾情況下，表示分布右側的 5%，

cues.en: is considered to be the region where we would call an effect to be statistically significant.
cues.zh: 會被視為效果具有統計顯著性的區域。

cues.en: On the other hand, if we're testing both tails, then we actually need to test both tails at alpha divided by two, so 0.025.
cues.zh: 另一方面，若檢驗兩尾，就必須對兩側各使用 α/2，也就是 0.025。

cues.en: And the reason for that is that we want a 5% probability in total from the entire distribution.
cues.zh: 因為希望整個分布的總機率為 5%。

cues.en: So if we're testing both tails, we have to cut up this 5% equally to the right side and to the left side of the distribution.
cues.zh: 檢驗兩尾時，必須把 5% 平分到分布右側和左側。

cues.en: So this leads to a kind of funny distinction, where hypotheses should be as specific as possible.
cues.zh: 這帶出一個有趣的區別，假設應該盡可能具體。

cues.en: So in fact, you want to specify your hypotheses as one tailed whenever possible.
cues.zh: 所以，只要可能，就希望將假設指定成單尾。

cues.en: And I gave several examples of this in the first video when I gave examples of good and bad hypotheses.
cues.zh: 第一部影片舉好、壞假設時，給過好幾個例子。

cues.en: So when you're setting up your research, when you're defining your hypotheses, you specify them as one tailed.
cues.zh: 設定研究、定義假設時，把它們指定成單尾。

cues.en: But in statistical tests, you're basically always doing two-tailed tests.
cues.zh: 但統計檢定中，基本上總是在做雙尾檢定。

cues.en: It's very unusual to do a one-tailed test.
cues.zh: 單尾檢定非常少見。

cues.en: We're always basically doing two-tailed tests.
cues.zh: 基本上總是雙尾。

cues.en: So I hope that's clear.
cues.zh: 希望說清楚了。

cues.en: The idea of a p-value is, it is the probability of observing a empirical test statistic.
cues.zh: P 值的概念，是觀察到某個實驗檢定統計量的機率。

cues.en: So a sample parameter from your experiment, from your data, given that the null hypothesis is actually true.
cues.zh: 也就是在虛無假設確實為真的條件下，實驗資料中的樣本參數。

cues.en: So that is a probability value.
cues.zh: 所以它是機率值。

cues.en: And the idea is when the probability is very small, it's very unlikely to observe a value in your data
cues.zh: 機率很小時，在虛無假設分布下，觀察到資料中

cues.en: as large as you did given the null hypothesis distribution, then we will say that that is a statistically significant effect.
cues.zh: 那麼大的值，非常不可能，就會稱為統計顯著效果。

cues.en: So p-values can be a little bit tricky to interpret.
cues.zh: P 值解讀可能有點棘手。

cues.en: So what I wanna do now is give you a few different examples of some common misinterpretations of p-values and then I will correct those misinterpretations.
cues.zh: 現在我要舉幾個 P 值常見誤解的例子，再修正這些誤解。

cues.en: Or actually you can as well.
cues.zh: 其實你也可以修正。

cues.en: So I'm telling you that this is wrong.
cues.zh: 先告訴你，這是錯的。

cues.en: This is not a correct way to interpret a p-value.
cues.zh: 這不是正確的 P 值解讀。

cues.en: So the misinterpretation is my p-value is 0.02, so, therefore, the effect is present for 2% of the population.
cues.zh: 誤解是，P 值為 0.02，所以效果存在於母體的 2%。

cues.en: Now that is incorrect.
cues.zh: 這不對。

cues.en: If you would like to pause the video and fix this statement or come up with another statement that is true, now's your opportunity to do so.
cues.zh: 如果想暫停影片修正，或提出另一個正確陳述，現在可以。

cues.en: Okay, so here is a corrected version.
cues.zh: 這裡是修正版本。

cues.en: It's longer, unfortunately, you know, this is always how it works.
cues.zh: 可惜比較長，事情總是這樣。

cues.en: The truth is always larger than the falsehoods.
cues.zh: 真相總比謊言長。

cues.en: So my p-value is 0.02.
So there is a 2% chance that there is no real effect, and my large sample statistic was actually due
cues.zh: 所以有 2% 的機率沒有真實效果，而我的大型樣本統計量，實際上是

cues.en: to variability noise, small sample size, systematic bias, something other than a real effect actually being present.
cues.zh: 變異、雜訊、小樣本、系統性偏差，或真實效果以外的因素所致。

cues.en: So again, the p-value doesn't mean that the effect is present for some proportion of the population.
cues.zh: 再次說明，P 值不代表效果存在於母體某個比例。

cues.en: It means that there is a 2% probability that there is no effect in the population and you just got your observed test statistic by chance.
cues.zh: 而是母體中沒有真實效果，只是偶然得到所觀察檢定統計量的機率為 2%。

cues.en: Okay, here's another one, another incorrect statement.
cues.zh: 再一個不正確的陳述。

cues.en: So my p-value is 0.02.
So there is a 98% chance that my sample statistic, so the statistic you observed in your sample data, equals the population parameter.
cues.zh: 所以有 98% 的機率，我的樣本統計量，也就是資料中觀察到的統計量，等於母體參數。

cues.en: This is also a really easy misinterpretation to make, in part because it would be nice if this were true.
cues.zh: 這也是很容易產生的誤解，一部分因為如果真的如此，會很棒。

cues.en: You know, it would be great if this is what the p-value actually meant, but unfortunately it's not quite that simple.
cues.zh: 如果 P 值真的有這個意思就太好了，但可惜沒那麼簡單。

cues.en: Again, if you'd like to pause the video and come up with a corrected version of this statement, then please do so.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，想一個修正版本。

cues.en: So a corrected version is looking something like this.
cues.zh: 修正後像這樣。

cues.en: In fact, this is literally exactly the same text as I had in the previous slide.
